meta.title: Migration
meta.description: Moving to this component from a schedule you wrote yourself, and where version-to-version changes are recorded.

scope: There is one migration guide so far: coming from a shift board your team built itself. It is the move this package was written for.
versions: Upgrades between versions of the package are recorded in the <link to="/discover-more/changelog/">Changelog</link>. A release that needs steps of its own gets its own page here, linked from the entry that introduces it.
